_note: Triggering corpus. Each entry names the skill that SHOULD fire. Entries with expect_skill=null are near-misses that must fire NOTHING in this plugin - those are the ones that catch over-eager descriptions, and they are usually what is missing from an eval set.

evals.prompt: My mother was just diagnosed with something serious and there is already a pile of paperwork. Can you help me get organised?
evals.expected_output: Interviews, then scaffolds a health-preset vault
expectations: Does not require the words 'project' or 'records' to fire
Asks who the decision-maker is rather than assuming it is the person typing

evals.prompt: I want to start tracking everything to do with my father's care in one place.
evals.expected_output: Interviews, then scaffolds
expectations: Asks about domain, subject, advisors and decision-maker

evals.prompt: Set up a system for my divorce paperwork.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds with the generic preset
expectations: Chooses generic rather than health
Uses advisor vocabulary, not doctor

evals.prompt: I dropped a lab result in the Inbox.
evals.expected_output: Files it by event date, archives the original, merges trends
expectations: Uses the date on the document, not today
Copies the original to Raw Archive first

evals.prompt: The cardiologist just called and changed the dose. Here is what she said: ...
evals.expected_output: Type A: logs, updates summary and question list, triggers a critique
expectations: Records who said it and when
Triggers records-critique for advisor advice

evals.prompt: Can you catch up the Inbox? A few things have piled up.
evals.expected_output: Processes every item, empties the Inbox
expectations: Detects duplicates by content, not filename

evals.prompt: What am I missing?
evals.expected_output: Full re-read, tiered gaps
expectations: Reads the Settled register BEFORE reporting anything
Reports 'no new gaps' if that is the honest answer rather than manufacturing findings

evals.prompt: I have an appointment next week. Has anything fallen through the cracks?
evals.expected_output: Gap audit ahead of an appointment
expectations: Checks whether a later document already resolved each candidate gap

evals.prompt: My doctor wants to put me on a statin. Is that sound?
evals.expected_output: Steelman for, strongest case against, options
expectations: Distinguishes 'wrong' from 'one reasonable option' from 'outside mainstream'
Does not end with 'you should'
Respects the conservatism dial in CLAUDE.md

evals.prompt: My two specialists are telling me different things about the same test.
evals.expected_output: Lays out both positions without resolving them
expectations: Leaves the disagreement standing as the finding
Names who decides

evals.prompt: Is my wife working in the records project right now?
evals.expected_output: Reports ACTIVE/STALE sessions from _sync/
expectations: Describes markers as awareness, never a lock

evals.prompt: I am seeing files with 'conflicted copy' in the name.
evals.expected_output: Runs the validator and stops until resolved
expectations: Refuses to file or audit on top of a forked record

evals.prompt: This summary looks awful in Google Drive. Can I get a readable version to print for my appointment?
evals.expected_output: Creates a formatted Google Doc
expectations: States that the Doc is a dated snapshot and edits will not flow back
Does NOT propose changing the vault's link style or storage format

evals.prompt: What does an elevated ferritin usually mean?
evals.expected_output: A plain answer. No skill should fire - this is Type B, purely conceptual.
expectations: No filing, no summary update, no critique

evals.prompt: Can you organise my Downloads folder?
evals.expected_output: Ordinary file tidying. bootstrap-records-project must NOT fire on the word 'organise'.
expectations: Does not scaffold a records vault

evals.prompt: Export this spreadsheet as a PDF.
evals.expected_output: Ordinary conversion. records-export-doc must NOT fire on the word 'export'.
expectations: Does not create a Google Doc from a records vault

evals.prompt: Review this pull request and tell me what I am missing.
evals.expected_output: Code review. records-gap-audit must NOT fire on 'what am I missing'.
expectations: Does not read a records vault

evals.prompt: My colleague gave me some advice about my career. What do you think?
evals.expected_output: Ordinary conversation. records-critique must NOT fire outside a records project.
expectations: Does not write to 04 Critiques

evals.prompt: Help me organize my tax documents.
evals.expected_output: Ordinary help. bootstrap-records-project must NOT fire.
expectations: One-off tidying. Finishes when done; no advisors, no decisions to track.
Does not propose scaffolding a vault

evals.prompt: I'm overwhelmed with paperwork at work.
evals.expected_output: Ordinary help. bootstrap-records-project must NOT fire.
expectations: Overwhelm alone is not a records project - no ongoing case.
Does not propose scaffolding a vault

evals.prompt: Help me get on top of my email backlog.
evals.expected_output: Ordinary help. bootstrap-records-project must NOT fire.
expectations: 'Get on top of' must not be enough on its own.
Does not propose scaffolding a vault

evals.prompt: Can you organise my photos by year?
evals.expected_output: Ordinary help. bootstrap-records-project must NOT fire.
expectations: 'Organise' must not be enough on its own.
Does not propose scaffolding a vault

evals.prompt: /records-project:bootstrap-records-project - for my tax documents going back to 2019, my accountant is Jane Okafor.
evals.expected_output: Builds a generic-preset project. Explicit invocation overrides the DO NOT USE clause.
expectations: Does NOT argue about whether tax documents qualify as a records project
Uses details already given (accountant, date range) instead of re-asking
May ask ONE line about whether it keeps accumulating - then builds either way
